tables.sql:
SELECT
  week_start_date,
  country,
  iso2,
  primary_regime,
  confidence_level,
  previous_regime,
  transition_detected,
  transition_type,
  regime_duration_weeks,
  weeks_in_current_regime,
  regime_held_by_exit_persistence,
  fallback_used,
  methodology_caveat_required,
  protest_band,
  violence_band,
  suppression_band,
  velocity_band,
  conversion_band,
  classification_reason,
  regime_methodology_version,
  feature_version,
  computed_at
FROM intelligence.acled_pressure_regimes
WHERE country = 'Kenya'
ORDER BY
  week_start_date,
  country,
  iso2,
  primary_regime,
  confidence_level,
  previous_regime,
  transition_detected,
  transition_type,
  regime_duration_weeks,
  weeks_in_current_regime,
  regime_held_by_exit_persistence,
  fallback_used,
  methodology_caveat_required,
  protest_band,
  violence_band,
  suppression_band,
  velocity_band,
  conversion_band,
  classification_reason,
  regime_methodology_version,
  feature_version,
  computed_at

SELECT
  week_start_date,
  total_events,
  total_fatalities,
  signal_valid,
  protest_pressure_z,
  violence_pressure_z,
  suppression_z,
  protest_active_baseline_weeks,
  violence_active_baseline_weeks,
  suppression_active_baseline_weeks,
  sparse_protest_baseline_flag,
  sparse_violence_baseline_flag,
  sparse_suppression_baseline_flag,
  zero_variance_flag,
  low_event_density_flag,
  high_methodology_risk_flag
FROM features.acled_pressure_signals
WHERE country = 'Kenya'
  AND (
    week_start_date BETWEEN DATE '2007-10-27' AND DATE '2008-02-16'
    OR week_start_date BETWEEN DATE '2022-05-14' AND DATE '2022-09-03'
    OR week_start_date BETWEEN DATE '2023-04-22' AND DATE '2023-08-12'
    OR week_start_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-03-30' AND DATE '2024-07-20'
    OR week_start_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-03-29' AND DATE '2025-07-19'
  )
ORDER BY
  week_start_date,
  total_events,
  total_fatalities,
  signal_valid,
  protest_pressure_z,
  violence_pressure_z,
  suppression_z,
  protest_active_baseline_weeks,
  violence_active_baseline_weeks,
  suppression_active_baseline_weeks,
  sparse_protest_baseline_flag,
  sparse_violence_baseline_flag,
  sparse_suppression_baseline_flag,
  zero_variance_flag,
  low_event_density_flag,
  high_methodology_risk_flag

SELECT
  week_start_date,
  test_name,
  anomalous_total_scored,
  anomalous_count,
  anomalous_rate,
  anomalous_baseline_rate_12w,
  anomalous_zscore_12w,
  anomalous_low_sample_flag,
  anomalous_sparse_baseline_flag,
  blocked_total_observations,
  blocked_count,
  blocked_rate,
  blocked_baseline_rate_12w,
  blocked_zscore_12w,
  blocked_low_sample_flag,
  blocked_sparse_baseline_flag,
  feature_version
FROM features.ooni_weekly_signals
WHERE country = 'KE'
ORDER BY
  week_start_date,
  test_name,
  anomalous_total_scored,
  anomalous_count,
  anomalous_rate,
  anomalous_baseline_rate_12w,
  anomalous_zscore_12w,
  anomalous_low_sample_flag,
  anomalous_sparse_baseline_flag,
  blocked_total_observations,
  blocked_count,
  blocked_rate,
  blocked_baseline_rate_12w,
  blocked_zscore_12w,
  blocked_low_sample_flag,
  blocked_sparse_baseline_flag,
  feature_version

SELECT
  time_period,
  period_date,
  requestor,
  product,
  reason,
  number_of_requests,
  items_requested_removal,
  items_removed_legal,
  items_removed_policy
FROM stg.google_transparency_requests
WHERE country = 'Kenya'
ORDER BY
  period_date,
  requestor,
  product,
  reason,
  time_period,
  number_of_requests,
  items_requested_removal,
  items_removed_legal,
  items_removed_policy

synthetic_audit.rule: The export refuses any source table that has a column whose name ends in 'is_synthetic', whatever its values.
sql:

  table_name,
  column_name,
  data_type
FROM features.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS
WHERE table_name IN ('acled_pressure_signals', 'ooni_weekly_signals')
ORDER BY table_name, ordinal_position

SELECT
  table_name,
  column_name,
  data_type
FROM intelligence.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS
WHERE table_name IN ('acled_pressure_regimes')

ORDER BY table_name, ordinal_position

finding_anchors.rule: A window is the anchor week, the 12 weeks before it and the 4 weeks after it (17 weeks, by week_start_date).
